ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are sparse and localized at the distal tips and as minute focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is characterized by a massive, contiguous dark-pigmented region. High-contrast white clusters are mapped exclusively to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, with secondary minor point-intensity mapping on the central-left lobe area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse-angled, shallow V-shaped central notch dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. A distinct, deeper jagged indentation is localized on the medial section of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex curve sweeping upwards and outwards toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of high-contrast white pixel clusters at the furthest lateral points of both fluke lobes, forming irregular roughly circular groupings.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-colored linear pixel disruptions are visible across the dark ventral surface, most notably in the central and left-central sectors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and focal notches along the trailing edge boundary; extensive white scarring visible at the distal tips of both lobes.
